svg.title: Adafruit 4899 512 MB SD wiring to Feather ESP32-S3
svg.text: Feather ESP32-S3 · disconnect USB and battery before soldering
Power VIN from the Feather’s main 3.3V rail; do not use IMU 3Vo or switched VIN.
IMU GND can share ground. Keep SPI wires short and connect them to the Feather.
Verify storage=sd, record a short test, and download it over USB or Wi-Fi. Stop/save before power-off.
Old 3V → VIN · CLK → SCK · DI → MOSI · DO → MISO · GND → GND · CS → CS
Match labels, not header positions. The 4899 has soldered storage: there is no removable card.
Board artwork: Adafruit · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Connection reference, not a mounting template
